structured_output.summary: Implemented the `allowlist` node of SELFHOST-2: appended the astral.sh uv installer's two redirect targets, `releases.astral.sh` and `release-assets.githubusercontent.com`, to `swfactory.doctor.GATEWAY_ALLOW_HOSTS` (now 8 entries; the six existing hosts are byte-identical and keep their order/position) and to the `ALLOW_HOSTS` bash array in `deploy/islo/bootstrap.sh`, in the same order. The bootstrap array stays a single unquoted, comment-free line so the hermetic text parse (`ALLOW_HOSTS=(` .. next `)`, split on whitespace) remains exact; the two new explanatory comment lines above it avoid the bare `ALLOW_HOSTS` token so a first-match parse still lands on the array line, and the existing idempotent `add-rule` loop and the `note` summary pick the hosts up unchanged. `gateway_fix` required no edit: it interpolates `' '.join(GATEWAY_ALLOW_HOSTS)`, so it now names both new hosts while keeping its `islo gateway create --name <profile> --default-action deny --internet-access true` prefix and `add-rule --host <host> --action allow` substring (R4-R6). Verification caveat, stated plainly: this environment exposed no shell tool, so I could not run `uv run --group dev pytest` — no test output is claimed. I verified by inspection instead: the only pre-existing consumer of the tuple is `tests/test_doctor.py:172`, which iterates it dynamically rather than pinning six entries, and `_check_gateway` validates only `default_action == "deny"` and `internet_enabled is True` without enumerating rules, so no check outcome, exit code, or `11 checks` table shape changes. The parity, prose, and loud-parse-failure tests belong to the sibling `tests` node and were left to it; no protected path was touched (R14).
